name: Sailvan Times Co., Ltd.
summary: Sailvan Times Co., Ltd. sells lifestyle products through third-party e-commerce platforms in China and internationally. The company offers women's sportswear, yoga wear, clothing, swimsuit, dresses, pajamas, workout clothes, and homewear under the Ekouaer, ZEAGOO, sheshow, retro stage, avidlove, coorun, and hotouch brands; girl's clothing under the arshiner brand; and men's pajamas and sportswear under the Coofandy brand name. It also provides modern lifestyle products, including clothing accessories, sports and entertainment, department stores and home furnishings through Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Wish, SHESHOW, Retro Stage, and various other e-commerce platforms.
